boxSubtitle: A Progressive Web App for seamless offline shopping management
boxChallenge: Users needed a reliable shopping list app that worked perfectly offline, synced across devices, and provided a native-app-like experience on the web.
boxSolution: I built a Vue.js-based PWA with Vuex for state management, implementing service workers for offline functionality and IndexedDB for local data persistence.
boxArchitecture: Frontend: Vue.js + Vuex + Vuetify | Offline: Service Workers + IndexedDB | Sync: Firebase Realtime Database
boxCodeDescription: This service worker intercepts network requests and serves cached content when offline, ensuring the app remains functional without internet.
classroomSubtitle: Enterprise-grade attendance tracking for educational institutions
classroomChallenge: Educational institutions needed a robust system to track student attendance, generate reports, and manage classroom data efficiently across multiple devices.
classroomSolution: I architected a full-stack solution with Next.js frontend and Spring Boot backend, implementing JWT authentication and real-time data synchronization.
classroomArchitecture: Frontend: Next.js + TypeScript | Backend: Spring Boot + Java | Database: PostgreSQL | Auth: JWT + OpenSSL
classroomCodeDescription: Secure authentication layer that validates JWT tokens and manages user sessions with automatic token refresh.
